title: Mini Outdoor Golf in Montreal
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
An activity accessible to all
Whether you are a beginner or a putting pro, Mini-Putt Montreal is designed for all ages and levels. With two 9-hole courses in various styles, everyone finds their pleasure — from children to adults.

A spectacular view
Play with stunning views of downtown Montreal and the St. Lawrence River. A unique outdoor setting that turns a simple game of mini golf into a memorable experience.

A strategic location in the heart of the Old Port
Located just steps from Montreal Bungee, the Science Centre and other major Old Port attractions, it’s the perfect stop on a summer day in Montreal.

Perfect for all types of outings
As a couple for a fun activity, with friends for a little friendly competition or with family for a joyful moment — it’s a simple, fun and unifying outing.
